specs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one production-quality 16:9 landscape game UI redesign concept, ideally 2048x1152, using the provided actual TalesTactics screenshot as the sole visual and game-content reference. This is an AFTER CONCEPT ONLY, not a before/after collage. Keep the existing recognizable stone sky citadel battlefield, original pixel-art character designs, enemy designs, six allied party members, blue crystal objectives, existing illustrated boot/swords/book/shield/hourglass/banner command icons, navy-and-antique-gold visual identity. Do not reinvent characters or turn the game into a generic 3D RPG. Preserve the existing game's art rather than introducing a different illustration universe.

Primary goals: readable units and improved information hierarchy. Reframe the SAME isometric map with a slightly more overhead orthographic camera, less giant cliff wall visible, the playable stone floor occupying most of the middle/right. The distant city should be atmospheric, darker, less contrast, softly hazed, while units and interactive crystal objectives remain crisp. Keep the floor dark neutral slate with restrained detail. Increase character visibility enough for six overlapping allies to be distinguishable, retain their lower-left battlefield cluster, use individual short HP bars anchored clearly to their bodies with tiny leader offsets only if needed. Friendly teal and enemy muted coral indicators, readable against the floor. Restrained selected-unit ornamental corner clasps and ground-contact shadows. No giant bloom, no bright yellow selection fill, no basic diamond placeholders, no long decorative arrows.

Layout: a compact top band, about 8% image height. Left mission text "귀환 신호 3개 연결 · 봉쇄 장치 파괴". Center 6 allied portrait badges with small illustrated move/action state symbols; header "아군 턴 1 · 미완료 5명". This is free-order ally phase, NOT a turn-order timeline. Right only compact "임무" and "설정" buttons. Below left, ONE coherent docked vertical navy command panel approximately 19% width with Cless portrait, "크레스 알베인", "Lv.4", readable HP 211 / 211 and MP 94 / 94, status "이동 가능 · 행동 가능", then six comfortable commands with the current illustrated icons: "이동", "공격", "기술", "방어", "대기", and a subtly separated "아군 턴 종료". Include small "위험 범위" toggle at panel bottom. Combine stats and commands in the same dock rather than separate distant windows. All text stays inside generous margins; only outer panel corners have ornate gold hardware, interior rows have fine understated separators. Current focus muted teal, labels ivory. No frame around every tiny number. Board remains dominant.
Use Korean sans-serif lettering, unusually clear and large for a real game. NO made-up damage forecasts in this command-idle state, no AP, no cover mechanic, no hit probability, no extra gameplay rules, no new camera buttons. Add a tiny discreet topmost label "개선안 · 구현 전 시안". The overall result should look like a plausible refined version of the supplied game, polished and implementable, not a marketing painting. Full-screen straight-on screenshot composition, no monitor, no device, no explanatory diagram or text outside the UI.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity 16:9 landscape AFTER redesign concept, ideally 2048x1152, for the TalesTactics party formation screen using the attached actual screenshot. Preserve the EXACT recognizable original six visible pixel sprites and Cless anime portrait, original illustrated class icons, turquoise-gem deployment crests, navy textured fantasy panels and antique gold hardware. No new characters or changing art style. No before/after collage.

Improve visual hierarchy and reading comfort while keeping one page of six visible roster cards in a 3 columns x 2 rows grid. Important game-state invariant: header says six deployed TOTAL, but on THIS page only FIVE are deployed and the sixth deployed is on page two. The visible cards are first row "크레스" Lv.4 (selected for inspection and deployed), "민트" Lv.1 (deployed), "파라" Lv.1 (deployed); second row "제이드" Lv.1 (deployed), "티아" Lv.1 (deployed), "나탈리아" Lv.1 (NOT deployed). Keep five ornate turquoise deployment medallions, and Natalia unmarked. Do not accidentally make Natalia deployed to match six. Keep page indicator "1 / 2", buttons "이전" and "다음", small honest caption "목록 내 출전 5명". Separate current inspected card from deployment status: Cless gets fine ornate selection corners and soft teal edge, all five deployed cards get the same deployment medallion, Natalia neutral.

Composition: one compact top bar "출전 편성", chapter "20화 각자의 하늘, 같은 약속", gold "300 G"; restrained small "거점", "설정" links. A narrow secondary navigation line for "편성", "장비", "상점", "성장", "임무" uses subdued tabs, not enormous framed buttons. Main left about 70% width holds roster: heading "출전 부대 6 / 6", small filter "전체 병과" and sort "기본순". Six slightly taller cards with sufficiently large sprites. Keep ALL each-card information within the card: illustrated class emblem upper left, deployment medallion upper right, sprite in central area, name and level in a legible dark footer band, and a compact integrated distinct action labelled "출전 중" on the first five and "출전 추가" on Natalia. No disconnected labels between rows. Thin quiet borders on unselected cards, only selected card gets stronger gold/teal focus. Exact silhouettes and costume identities from reference.
Right about 27% width is a compact selected-character summary: Cless portrait large but balanced, "크레스 알베인", "시공검사 · Lv.4", HP 211/211 and MP 94/94; readable two-column stats from reference (공격 48, 방어 22, 마력 30, 마방 19, 민첩 23, 이동 4); three compact equipment slots using illustrated weapon/armor/necklace icons and labels "무기 없음", "방어구 없음", "장신구 없음". Lower quiet shortcuts "능력", "장비", "성장", plus compact "출전 제외".
Bottom full-width clean action strip: secondary "프리셋", "전체 해제", "추천 편성"; one strong primary muted-teal "출전 확정" button at right. A short instruction "카드: 정보 보기   출전 버튼: 편성 변경". Gold ornament only on major outer-frame corners, quieter interior borders. Dark textured background remains low contrast, text ivory, selected teal, no large yellow blocks, no generic check marks or diamonds. Large crisp Korean sans-serif. Add discreet topmost "개선안 · 구현 전 시안". This must feel like the same game coherently reorganized, not a completely new game or generic dashboard.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity 16:9 landscape AFTER concept, ideally 2048x1152, for TalesTactics equipment management using the attached current game screenshot as reference. Preserve original character pixel sprite and portraits, existing navy textured panels, understated antique gold details, illustrated bronze sword. Do not add new fantasy items, characters, gameplay systems, rarity tiers, or currencies. This is one redesigned full-screen game screenshot, not a before/after collage.

Current actual scene: chapter "2화 불꽃과 가시", 300 G, available character portraits "크레스", "민트", "알펜", "시온". Cless selected, "크레스 알베인", "시공검사 · Lv.4". Available weapon "청동검", quantity "사용 가능 1". Existing current equipment all three slots empty. Proposed screenshot explicitly shows the user has selected bronze sword as a DRAFT, not yet equipped/saved. Bronze sword's REAL bonus is attack +4; do not invent any other stat effect. Use a clear label "장착 미리보기 · 아직 저장되지 않음". No invented base stat numbers: just "공격 +4", "다른 능력치 변화 없음". Never imply cosmetic sprite is a dynamic weapon swap for this generic sword; preserve reference Cless sprite identity.

Layout goal is compact contextual comparison, replacing the huge unused inventory area. Top compact bar "장비 정비", chapter and gold; quiet navigation "편성 · 장비 · 상점 · 성장 · 임무" with equipment focused muted teal. Below a compact horizontal strip of the four available character portraits, with name labels and Cless selected; no future characters or placeholder silhouettes.
Main area has three balanced columns (about 26%, 30%, 38%). Left: Cless sprite, name/job, and three current-equipped slots "무기 · 없음", "방어구 · 없음", "장신구 · 없음", using real illustrated equipment icons. Center: heading "보유 장비" with small tabs "무기", "방어구", "장신구", one clear selected compact sword row with original bronze sword illustration, "청동검", "공격 +4", "사용 가능 1"; below concise quiet empty-list hint "다른 호환 무기가 없습니다". Not a gigantic blank card. Right: header "장착 비교"; a side-by-side pair "현재 장착" with "없음" and "선택한 후보" with bronze sword image "청동검"; below a prominent readable positive teal "공격 +4", and "다른 능력치 변화 없음". Small "전체 능력치" disclosure and "변경 1건 · 미적용" state badge. Each column content aligned in a coherent frame, open space intentional not stretched buttons.
Bottom primary action strip contains clear status "청동검을 장착하면 변경 사항이 저장됩니다.", secondary button "변경 취소", and primary muted teal "장착하고 저장". A quieter "거점" navigation control near top. Keep acquisition separate: no purchase button for this owned item. All writing comfortably inside generous safe margins. Ornate gold only on major outer frame corners, fine separators inside, no multiple heavy nested frames, no bright yellow fill, no simple geometric placeholders, no decorative check marks. Large legible Korean sans-serif; material detail restrained enough that text dominates. Tiny topmost caption "개선안 · 구현 전 시안". Same game's practical refined layout, not marketing artwork.
